references.text: The same age requirement (one month and older) is mentioned for the counting of the Levites, but with a different purpose than service.
The same age limit (30–50 years) is given for Kohath's sons who are to serve at the tent of meeting.
The same age limit (30–50 years) is given for Gershon's sons who are to serve at the tent of meeting.
The same age limit (30–50 years) is given for Merari's sons who are to serve at the tent of meeting.
A parallel verse that also describes the counting of Merari's sons with the same age requirement.
Summary of all Levites between 30 and 50 years old who were counted for service at the tent of meeting.
Specifies the age limits for the Levites' service, from 25 years until 50 years when they were to retire.
David changed the age limit for the Levites' service to 20 years, showing the development of service requirements.
